title: feat: news page with dated announcements and the news feed
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- News page now has two sections: **Announcements** and **News** (FAQ unchanged below).
- **Announcements**: one dated row per item (date · New/Retiring/Updating · name · change), using Elliot's row layout from #16336. New launches show for two weeks; upcoming changes hide after their date; the section hides when empty.
- Current rows: Sandboxes (New, Oct 2), Pay with crypto (New, Oct 6), and the Qwen, Command A+, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite and Grok Imagine Pro changes. Retirement dates match `retirementDate` in the registry.
- Moves Command A+ `retirementDate` from Oct 13 to Oct 9 so it retires with the Qwen3 routes (metadata only; no code reads it).
- **News**: the automatic daily feed, unchanged.
- Removes the hand-written announcement cards, which never expired and only described changes that had already shipped.

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Top section | 7 never-expiring cards about past changes | New launches (2 weeks) + upcoming changes, each auto-hidden |
| Second section | Daily news feed | Daily news feed |

Checked: Enter and Gen `tsc`, Biome, `/news` rendered at 1280px and 390px with no horizontal overflow.

gist.headline: News with an expiration date
gist.blurb: The news page gets dated announcements that know when to leave. The daily feed and FAQ keep their usual spots.
gist.summary: The /news page replaces seven never-expiring cards with dated New, Retiring, and Updating rows: launches remain for two weeks, upcoming changes hide after their dates, and the daily news feed stays unchanged.
gist.impact: Readers get a clearer view of launches and upcoming model changes, including Sandboxes, crypto payments, and Qwen, Command A+, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, and Grok Imagine Pro updates; the announcements section hides when empty.
